mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have mainly clear skies with a temperature of 81 degrees at Verona City Hall and a moderate air quality index of 54. The moon is currently in its third quarter phase.

In city news, the engineering department continues to work with AECOM on regular service reports, which are presented to the City Council at each meeting to keep the public informed on local infrastructure. Also, the Senior Center is currently promoting their tri-shaw bike program, where you can sign up for a free ride along the Military Ridge State Trail.

We have a busy couple of days ahead. Today you can catch live music at Baileys Run Vineyard. Tomorrow, the Dane County Farmers Market will be at the Capitol Square, and Paddy Mac's will host a music series. On Saturday, August 9, the Verona Ice Arena is hosting a free Girls Try Hockey event.
Looking at the weekly report, on August 2, a 49-year-old Verona man who had previously fled from an officer was finally located and taken into custody for bail jumping and resisting arrest.

Today's flavor is the decadent Really Reese's, which you can enjoy until the shop closes at 10:30 PM. Additionally, if you are out and about today, Kona Ice will be at Fireman's Park in Verona from 11 AM to 4 PM.
